description: After a compaction, reminds the model of the chat language (the summary is English and not a user message). Once per plugin version, creates ~/.config/youtrack-task/config.toml from config.example.toml or syncs it (adds new options commented out, removes obsolete ones). Guards direct YouTrack create_issue calls (an Assignee must always be set, text in the user's language), confines the `all` sub-command's worker and reviewer subagents (no pushes or merges, read-only reviewer, worker file writes only inside its worktree), and — only when review_gate_hook is on — blocks pushing or opening a PR for an issue branch without a review stamp.
